meta.purpose: Inputs for tools/build_readiness.py. Gate wording, templates and links are authored here. Every measured value is computed by the builder from the named file.
meta.rule: A clearing number is either computed from a named file, quoted from a named gate in data/gates.json, or marked 'proposed' (a threshold chosen by this round, not a fact from a source). A value that cannot be measured stays blank and is flagged. Nothing is inferred.
meta.template_keys: {key} is replaced by the value the builder measured for that key. An unknown key fails the build.

R-07.gate: Our own side line must beat the market benchmark out of sample. On the 2015-2026 walk-forward window it does not.
R-07.measured: Side MAE {side_mae_model} (model) vs {side_mae_market} (market) over {n_side} games; gap {side_mae_gap} points.
R-07.clears: Close a side-MAE gap of {side_mae_gap} points against the market benchmark, out of sample.
R-07.basis: data/lab/lines/model_report.json (accuracy block; the test window is published in the same file).

R-08.gate: G1 sample size and G2 skill above variance. One strategy passes every gate, and its bet count is below the singles threshold in data/gates.json.
R-08.measured: {lb_pass} of {lb_rows} strategies pass; the passing strategy has {lb_pass_bets} bets.
R-08.clears: {g1_gates} singles bets (G1). The passing strategy is short by {g1_short} bets.

R-09.gate: A random-picks control on every leaderboard run. No random-picks control is computed. One always-favourite baseline is shared by all runs and is not a per-run control.
R-09.measured: {lb_random_control} of {lb_rows} runs carry a random-picks control. Shared always-favourite ROI {lb_fav_roi_pct}%.
R-09.clears: {lb_rows} of {lb_rows} runs carry a random-picks control.
R-09.basis: Owner brief: control baseline (random picks; favourites only) on every leaderboard run.

R-10.gate: Reward rules, funding and legality are undefined. The register cites Q-09 for this, but Q-09 in data/questions.json is 'Market scope'. Rewards are Q-07 there and Q-20 in data/audit/decision_questions.json.
R-10.measured: 0 reward rules recorded. Open questions: Q-07 (data/questions.json) and Q-20 (decision_questions.json).
R-10.clears: 1 owner-approved reward rule set, with legality checked, closing Q-07 / Q-20.

R-11.gate: A parlay or prop combo may be ranked only with a directly validated joint probability and the operator's void and push rules (G7). Multiplying marginals is not allowed.
R-11.measured: {files_joint} joint-probability files in the repository, against {g7_families} combo families under G7.
R-11.clears: {g7_families} of {g7_families} families with a holdout-calibrated joint probability.
R-11.basis: data/gates.json, G7 applies_to (cross-game parlay, same-game parlay, prop combo).

R-12.gate: The G1 sample threshold differs between registers, so the pass rule is not one rule. README.md and app/validation.html say 100. data/gates.json says 500.
R-12.clears: One G1 threshold in both registers (1 of 1 agreed).
R-12.basis: README.md line 'G1 | Sample sufficiency | >= 100'; data/gates.json G1.

R-13.gate: Correlations cover team-stat pairs only. No player-to-market pair has an official source, so the blocked pairs are not computed.
R-13.measured: {corr_official} official team-stat pairs (n = 32 each); {corr_player} player-market pairs.
R-13.clears: Player-market pairs with n_eff of at least 500 (the G1 props threshold).

R-14.gate: Luck removal has bootstrap and sign-flip tests. It has no game-cluster lower bound and no multiplicity adjustment, and no cluster file exists in the repository.
R-14.measured: {files_cluster} cluster files. {res_official} of {res_rows} results are officially verified.
R-14.clears: {g1_gates} official settled singles bets (G1). Official settled today: {res_official}.

R-15.gate: Daily captures from Wednesday to kickoff, each with a fetch timestamp and a retained hash. The repository holds one dated report, and the injury file has one git commit (observed 2026-11-15).
R-15.measured: {inj_dates} capture date(s); {inj_rows} rows in the published Week 10 table.
R-15.clears: 5 daily captures per game week (Wednesday to Sunday), each retained.
R-15.basis: Owner brief (Wednesday to kickoff, daily). The scheduled refresh (.github/workflows/data-refresh.yml) runs every 6 hours; its output is not retained as a series.

R-16.gate: Depth charts parsed from {depth_clubs} of {standings_rows} clubs. The Houston depth chart is an image and is not parsed.
R-16.clears: {standings_rows} of {standings_rows} clubs parsed from an authorised source.
R-16.basis: Owner brief: run the 32-team sweep before any team-level model is trusted.

R-17.gate: Offence needs starter and backup status from snap counts or official inactive lists. Neither is in the repository.
R-17.clears: Snap counts or official inactive lists for all {res_2026_final} final 2026 games (0 covered today).

R-19.gate: The scheduled refresh runs without a person, but nothing retains a series of captures and nothing alarms when a source or schema changes.
R-19.clears: 5 consecutive daily captures retained, with no manual step.

R-20.gate: An open re-capture (PR #49, another session) reports 16 differing rows and 2 absent rows against the published table. It is not reconciled. This round checked 4 of 28 clubs against nfl.com and found no difference, but that is not a full re-verification.
R-20.measured: {inj_rows} published rows. Round-4 spot check of nfl.com (2026-11-15): {spot_players} players in {spot_clubs} clubs, {spot_mismatch} mismatches (data/audit/round4_spotcheck_injuries.csv). PR #49 reports 16 differing and 2 absent (its report, not re-verified here).

R-33.measured: One branch per session (COORDINATION.md platform constraint).

R-46.measured: Spread: {price_oc_spread} of {games} games. Total: {price_oc_total} of {games}. Moneyline: {price_oc_ml} of {games}. Official rows: {price_official} of {price_rows}.
R-46.clears: Official opening and closing lines for all {games} games in 3 markets, which is {games3} pairs. Official pairs today: 0.

flags.title: G1 sample threshold conflicts between registers
flags.detail: README.md and app/validation.html say 100 settled out-of-sample bets. data/gates.json says {g1_gates} singles bets. The one strategy that passes every gate has {lb_pass_bets} bets, which passes the first and fails the second.

flags.title: Reward-rule cross-reference points at the wrong question
flags.detail: The register row R-10 cites Q-09 for reward rules. In data/questions.json Q-09 is 'Market scope'. Rewards are Q-07 there, and Q-20 in data/audit/decision_questions.json.

flags.title: Headline model error does not match the model report
flags.detail: The landing page states a spread MAE of 10.42 for the model and 9.73 for the market. data/lab/lines/model_report.json publishes side MAE {side_mae_model} (model) and {side_mae_market} (market) over {n_side} games. The landing figures were not reproduced from data/lab/lines/fair_lines.csv under either sign convention. Published as found; the text was not changed.

flags.title: Results feed is one day behind official finals
flags.detail: On 2026-11-15 nfl.com shows the Patriots-Lions game (Munich) as Final, 10-35. The feed records it as scheduled, with no score, because it was built on 2026-11-14. {res_2026_sched} 2026 rows are still 'scheduled'. There is no freshness alarm.

flags.title: Injury captures are overwritten, not retained
flags.detail: The scheduled refresh runs successfully, but data/injuries/injuries_2026_week10.csv has one git commit (observed 2026-11-15, git log). A series of dated captures does not exist, so the 'continuous' claim in R-15 cannot be checked back in time.

flags.title: Open injury re-capture disagrees with the published table
flags.detail: PR #49 (another session, open) reports that the official page carries 347 rows, with 16 published rows differing and 2 absent. This round did not re-verify that report, and the published table has not changed.

flags.title: Nine requirement rows recorded as met are partly met on the data
flags.detail: Nine rows were recorded as met and are partly met on the data: R-12 (threshold conflict), R-14 (no cluster bound), R-15 (one capture date, no retained series), R-16 (31 of 32 depth charts), R-17 (no snap counts or inactive lists), R-20 (open re-capture), R-46 (price pairs), R-47 (official rows) and R-49 (mirror market lines). Their register text is unchanged, and this round's state is shown beside it.
